texts:
Friday's final injury reports are in for Week 6. Eight fantasy players are out, nobody we play is doubtful, and eight are questionable.

Jeremiyah Love is out.

Lamar Jackson is out.

Rashee Rice is out.

Let's get into it.
#BirdGang #RavensFlock #ChiefsKingdom

Jeremiyah Love (ankle) missed every practice and will not play @LAR.

Tyler Allgeier had 60 percent of the snaps in Weeks 1 and 2. Pivot to him, RB23 for me, an RB2.

The Rams have no skill player on the report. Puka Nacua is WR1 for me.
#BirdGang #RamsHouse

Lamar Jackson (ankle) has not practiced since Oct. 4 and is out @CLE. Tyler Huntley starts.

Pivot to Kirk Cousins, QB13 for me vs BUF, a borderline start this week.

Zay Flowers was limited with the toe but has no designation. WR9 for me.
#RavensFlock #RaiderNation

Quinshon Judkins (ankle) is questionable after missing Wednesday and Thursday, then going limited Friday. Dylan Sampson is out.

RB35 for me if he is active, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play. Monitor Cleveland's inactives at 11:30 AM ET.
#DawgPound

Rashee Rice (hamstring, knee) did not practice all week and is out vs LAC.

Xavier Worthy is the top outside receiver left in Kansas City. Pivot to him, WR30 for me, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.
#ChiefsKingdom

Tre Harris (hamstring) is out again for the Chargers @KC.

Omarion Hampton had 14 carries for 33 vs DEN. RB24 for me, an RB2 at the bottom of the range.

Keaton Mitchell is RB28 for me, a high-end flex play.
#BoltUp

Saquon Barkley (hamstring) missed every practice and is out vs CAR, and Will Shipley (foot) is out too.

Dameon Pierce led Philadelphia with 11 carries in Week 5 and has the backfield. Pivot to him, RB20 for me, an RB2.
#FlyEaglesFly

Jalen Hurts (calf) is out; Tanner McKee starts. Pivot to Tyler Shough, QB12 for me @NYG, a borderline start this week.

DeVonta Smith practiced Friday and has no designation. He is off my list with McKee throwing; sit him.
#FlyEaglesFly #Saints

AJ Dillon (ankle) is out for Carolina @PHI.

Chuba Hubbard ran 20 times for 122 and 2 TDs vs DET before the bye. RB11 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

Tetairoa McMillan is WR17 for me, a WR2.
#KeepPounding

Breece Hall (quad) is out a third straight game @NE.

Braelon Allen played all but two snaps the last time Hall sat. Pivot to him, RB18 for me, an RB2.

Garrett Wilson has no designation. WR10 for me.
#JetUp

A.J. Brown (ankle) was limited all week in his window off IR and is questionable vs NYJ. Monitor Saturday's roster moves at 4:00 PM ET; in a first game back he is a dart throw at most.

Rhamondre Stevenson played 71 percent of the snaps vs LV. RB12 for me.
#NEPats

David Montgomery (groin) is out and did not travel to London.

Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps at TEN after Montgomery left. Pivot to him, RB19 for me @JAX, an RB2.

Nico Collins has no designation. WR8 for me.
#HTownMade

Jacksonville has no skill player on the report for the 9:30 AM ET London game.

Brenton Strange caught 14 of 16 targets for 163 the last two weeks. TE12 for me, a borderline start this week.

Parker Washington is WR11 for me, borderline WR1/WR2.
#DUUUVAL

Baker Mayfield (right thumb) did not practice and is out vs PIT. Jalon Daniels starts again.

Pivot to C.J. Stroud, QB14 for me @JAX, a borderline start this week.

Bucky Irving has no designation. RB14 for me, borderline RB1/RB2.
#GoBucs #HTownMade

Rico Dowdle (toe) is questionable after full practices Thursday and Friday. Sit him in his first game back.

Jaylen Warren has topped 126 total yards three straight games. RB6 for me @TB.
#HereWeGo

DK Metcalf (illness) missed Friday after two full days and is questionable @TB. WR26 for me if he plays, a high-end WR3. Monitor Pittsburgh's inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

Germie Bernard ran 32 routes on 34 dropbacks vs IND. WR34 for me, the fallback.
#HereWeGo

Caleb Williams (hamstring) is questionable after three full practices. QB8 for me @ATL; check Chicago's inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) has no designation. QB20 for me, outside my top 12.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

Tyler Warren (groin) was added Friday as limited after two full days and is questionable vs TEN. TE8 for me if he plays. Monitor Indianapolis's inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

Juwan Johnson is TE9 for me, the fallback.
#ForTheShoe #Saints

Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable after a full Friday. RB39 for me, a dart throw.

Tony Pollard has no designation. RB21 for me @IND, an RB2.

Carnell Tate is WR23 for me, a WR2.
#TitanUp

Chris Olave (illness) missed two days, then was limited Friday. WR6 for me @NYG; check New Orleans' inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

Alvin Kamara (back) was limited all week and is questionable. RB29 for me, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.
#Saints

Theo Johnson (neck) is out for the Giants vs NO.

Isaiah Likely gets the tight end targets in New York. TE4 for me.

Malik Nabers had 20 targets in the tie @WAS. WR7 for me.
#NYGiants

Buffalo and Las Vegas had not posted Friday designations at 5:30 PM ET.

DJ Moore (shoulder) missed Wednesday and Thursday and is off my list. Khalil Shakir is WR35 for me, a low-end WR3.

Brock Bowers practiced in full Thursday. TE1 for me.
#BillsMafia #RaiderNation

CeeDee Lamb practiced in full this week with no designation. WR3 for me @GB Sunday night.

Skyy Moore (ankle) is out for Green Bay. Christian Watson had 6 catches for 143 and 2 TDs vs CHI. WR4 for me.
#DallasCowboys #GoPackGo

Washington and San Francisco post designations Saturday for Monday night.

Mike Evans (ribs, Achilles) sat Thursday. WR12 for me, borderline WR1/WR2; monitor Saturday's report.

Terry McLaurin (hamstring) rested Friday. WR21 for me, a WR2.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Every designation, practice report and pivot is in Prep Notes on the site, and the Menu is refreshed with the outs.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's inactives and pivots, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/prep.html?week=6
